二维码对清晰度和大小比较敏感。常见情况与对策： · 太小：把二维码放大（或把截图: QR codes are sensitive to sharpness and size. Common cases and fixes: · Too small: zoom the code (or the screenshot) and frame it again; · Blurry / glare: change the angle, avoid the highlight, capture again; · Only part of it framed: the selection must fully include the quiet margin around the code; · Still failing after a clean frame: the result window says why — click “Frame again” to retry without closing it.

按住任意一项上下拖动即可调整顺序，松手立刻保存；也可以直接在右上角的预览里拖动格: The list order is the grid order — drag any row up or down to reorder and it saves on release; you can also drag cells right in the preview above and the two stay in sync. The grid holds rows × columns items, but rows grow by themselves: when it fills up another row appears, and deleting items takes it back. There are three ways to add: the “+ Add item” button above, the dashed cell in the grid page, or “Add to grid page” on any feature row. The dropdown at the right of each row sets how that cell is drawn (follow default / icon + name / icon only / name only) — the default lives under Appearance → Cell text, this only overrides that one row. Feature cells (the ones with no URL behind the icon): “Text recognition” frames the screen and reads the text, “Image search” frames a picture and searches by it, “Translate” translates the text currently on the bar, “Wrap symbols” opens a set of symbol pairs ("" «» 【】 …) to wrap / unwrap / swap around the selection. Which model does recognition and translation is decided by the one selected in Settings → Extras (the same setting the bar button uses).

用法和「文字识别」完全一样：先把当前画面冻住，再框住二维码， 自动解出里面的内容: Works exactly like “Text recognition”: freeze the current screen, frame the code, and the content is decoded automatically. When it works you can open it in the browser, copy the link, or drop the whole text into a search. Decoding is local (no network, no upload), so it works offline.
